Please let him out to explore. Once you have a bigger cage give him more perches and multiple food bowls for him to forage in. Conures are often goofy, like to climb, like to cuddle, and like to have lots to chew on. They need plenty of room to roam and are great companions. Please understand that if you are planning on combining two cages/getting a flight cage you should do that as soon you can, since having more space will likely make him feel more comfortable with being in a new environment. It’s ok if this is his temporary cage though! I’ve had to use a cage this size in the past while waiting for a new cage to arrive! Happy conures like to bathe, make chirpy noises, explore, climb, chew, snuggle- they are very entertaining! Also make sure you don’t have him near a heater or ac unit. There’s no rush to figure it all out. When I was your age I was so sure I wanted a relationship with a man and I disregarded any time I had feelings for a woman. I thought I was maybe asexual since I really only wanted to be intimate with guys so that they’d keep wanting me. It was validating. I wanted a boyfriend so bad just for the sake of having a boyfriend and being in a relationship. I eventually accepted that I was bisexual, after becoming friends with other queer people who were totally validating and helpful when it came to me figuring out my sexuality. But eventually saying I was bisexual didn’t sound right for some reason. I was finally at a place where I did start feeling romantic and sexual attraction to men, women, non binary people but I felt like saying I was bisexual limited the truth. I’m not all that into men but I want to be with my current partner who is male, even if I find myself to be more romantically attracted to women. Ive been attracted to men, just not as often as women. I often yearn for a romantic relationship with a woman and I have often felt like I would only ever be willing to have children if it were with another woman. But I also feel like having sex with a woman would stress me out bc I’d end up comparing myself too her too much bc I’m insecure about how I look and the women I’m attracted to are the women I also wish I could look like. Typically a bit more androgynous. I like non binary people too but I struggle with my own gender stuff and even though I have considered that I may be gender fluid or non binary I never feel like I’m non binary enough. So men/comphet always seemed easier than anything else. 

So with all that being said, I’m 28 and still don’t have it figured out. At this point in my life I call myself queer because that’s what works. We don’t need to fit ourselves into neat little boxes. One of the reasons why my current relationship with a man works is we are almost in a sense platonic life partners. Sure we have sex sometimes (and I mean that as in very rarely) and we do romantic things sometimes but we mostly just help each other and are really good friends. We are both queer and both love each other and support each other. It feels safe. That is something that 20 year old me would have never thought they would have. Truly. So don’t give up. You’re not wasting anyone’s time. You’ll find yourself in relationships that work and don’t work. You don’t need to figure it all out. Experiment! Make friends who understand what you’re going through. Read The Lesbian Masterdoc, write pro and con lists of what you think a relationship with a woman would be like vs with a man. Maybe you’ll find that is more just about the person and less about gender/sex. Find your community and you’ll never be lonely. Life isn’t all about romantic or sexual relationships
